The '''Enabler I speech/sound system''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Vocabulator/Legends|vocabulator]]. The ancient [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[CKO-171]] was equipped with an Enabler I, which produced a grating approximation of [[Human/Legends|Human]] speech.
